payload.name: Confirm Ambiguous Keep or Revert Instructions
payload.description: When an instruction to keep, revert or leave something is ambiguous and touches a recorded doctrine, the doctrine's state is kept and one short question is asked, instead of guessing.

principles.name: A guess re-touches every file
principles.description: Flipping a decision back and forth multiplies edits and hides the real state.

heuristics.condition: the same area was changed back and forth in this session
heuristics.action: stop and ask before a third change

decision_rules.name: Keep the recorded state
decision_rules.condition: a keep, revert or leave instruction is unclear and concerns a recorded doctrine
decision_rules.outcome: leave the doctrine's current state unchanged

decision_rules.name: Ask one line
decision_rules.outcome: ask one short question naming both readings, then act on the answer

decision_rules.name: Record the final state
decision_rules.outcome: record it in the memory and the checklist so the next session does not flip it
